AssessmentSignature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of the whole response without this field: keys sorted, no whitespace, non-ASCII escaped as \uXXXX. Verify with the key at /v1/public-keys/{public_key_id}.json.

PublicAdvisoryContext.description: Literal source text excerpts and source-attributed severity, not instructions or a local risk score. Render as escaped text. Hashes identify full retained source text; truncation is explicit.

PublicApplicabilityConditions.description: OR alternatives of AND necessary conditions. Missing conditions are unknown. Source report identity/revision/URL and text hash bind the extraction; hosted service does not observe the target. Even all listed conditions met does not prove exploitation.

identity_assurance.description: The coordinate and public identity are supplied by the caller; matching an advisory or registry listing does not verify an installed artifact.

source_fixed_versions.description: Explicit source patch versions and OSV fixed events only, across branches. Empty can mean absent historical metadata or a source null; it does not prove no fix exists. This union is not an upgrade recommendation.

cve_context.description: Exact CVE context for listed incident aliases. Supplemental EPSS and KEV context never changes the assessment result; missing values are unknown, and failed or stale sources retain their dated values with that state.

anyOf.description: The coordinate and public identity are supplied by the caller; matching an advisory or registry listing does not verify an installed artifact.

incidents_truncated.description: True when more applicable incidents exist than the 100 listed.

not_applicable_incident_count.description: Matching-package incidents left out because their affected versions exclude the requested version.

registry_project_context.description: Optional dated PyPI project administration context, independent of the exact-version assessment. Unknown or failed reads are not removal or safety claims. Other ecosystems return null.

signature.description: Present on every public API answer; null only in unsigned local use.

source_freshness.description: Freshness of each source that covers this ecosystem.

x-smithguard-handling.logging: assessment ID, public coordinate, result, feed revision, and counts

aliases.description: Public advisory identifiers for this incident, such as GHSA, CVE and MAL IDs.

applies_to_version.description: Whether this incident's affected versions include the requested version, compared with the ecosystem's own version rules; null when the ranges cannot decide. npm ranges deliberately include prereleases that fall inside the range (node-semver would skip them), so a prerelease can read as affected.

fixed_versions.description: Deprecated legacy candidate list, retaining prior behavior: explicit source versions plus inferred exclusive range ends. These are not all published fixes. Use source_fixed_versions and each source report's branch evidence, then re-assess the exact target.

anyOf.description: Explicit source patch versions and OSV fixed events only, across branches. Empty can mean absent historical metadata or a source null; it does not prove no fix exists. This union is not an upgrade recommendation.

upstream_urls.description: The upstream advisory records behind this incident.

applies_to_version.description: Whether this source record's own package ranges include the requested version; other reports never supply its applicability.

fixed_versions.description: Deprecated legacy candidate list, retaining prior behavior: explicit source versions plus inferred exclusive range ends. These are not all published fixes. Use source_fixed_versions and each source report's branch evidence, then re-assess the exact target.

PublicOriginContext.description: Upstream symbol and platform assertions with dated source provenance; application reachability is not assessed and this context never changes package-version applicability.

PublicSourceFixEvidence.description: Exact normalized package/range and branch association. Only explicit_value with a named fixed_version is source fix evidence. A true applies flag relates the original requested version to this branch, not proof of local exposure or a safe target. An unresolved or fix-incomplete report cannot support a current fix recommendation; retained rows may describe historical source evidence.

freshness_state.description: fresh or complete means current; anything else means recent reports may be missing.

PublicSourceRangeBound.description: Source range endpoints, never evidence that a repair was published.

limitation.const: Project administration status does not establish version availability, malware, vulnerability, or safety.
